signature.objects: tag B and horizontal dimension arrow

prompt: One SQUARE 1:1 flat software icon on white. A large dark-blue tag shape with a large white B inside, both B counters clearly open. Above the tag, a thick orange horizontal double-headed dimension arrow spans the tag width, with large separated arrowheads. The B indicates bytes and the dimension arrow indicates tag buffer size. No other letters or numbers; no weighing scale, no shadow, generous white margins.
